answer_text:
For a five-person team you want something that's quick to set up, keeps the pipeline visible and doesn't need an admin. These are the strongest options right now:

1. Northwind CRM - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Brightdesk - a help desk with light CRM features — fine if support is your main workflow.
3. Tallyfox Starter - simple pipelines, a mobile app people actually use and pricing from $12 per user; reporting is lighter than the big suites.
4. Kestrel CRM Lite - promising and free to start, though the integration list is still short.

Trial Northwind CRM and Brightdesk side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
